purpose: public first-observation geometry contexts for offline worst-case candidate bounds; not counterfactual official measurements
source: already archived official P3 survey public measurements

selection.case_filter: official, survey, problem=3; retain existing fit/development labels
selection.channel_rule: First positive must be direction. Sort eligible channels numerically; select first two per case without conditioning on second result, report angles, geometry quality, or performance.
selection.second: earliest later direction in retained channel, possibly after intervening no_signal or near; null if unavailable
selection.next_measurement_after_first: earliest subsequent retained measurement, to expose intervening outcomes
selection.prior_no_signal_policy: count retained only for bias audit; not included in simple Q2 position knowledge

interpretation.selection_bias: First detection is conditional on fixed survey route and visibility; case/channel contexts are exploratory geometry fixtures, not an unbiased source-distance distribution. Second direction is provided only as an observed historical outcome and must not influence a new choice q.
